title: Slide 6: The life between.

items.text: Life is rarely about just one thing.
We meet for coffee, but stay for lunch. We come to shop, but end up meeting friends. We bring our children to play, then sit down for dinner.
Batam is shaped by movement: between Indonesia and the region, work and leisure, local life and new experiences. The district brings those different sides of life together.
SUPPLIED CONCEPT IMAGERY · NOT VERIFIED AS BUILT / 06
